fusions.name: Thunder of Small Feet
fusions.desc: A stampede of rats thunders through a cone 6 tiles long and deals 30 damage to everything in it, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Ridden Down
fusions.desc: Runs down one enemy at or below 30% health, dealing 22 damage and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Heart
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 20% for 12 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Gathered Gallop
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, your physical damage rises by 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
